item.title: Columbia County school board member Kristi Baker won’t seek another term
item.description: Kristi Baker, a longtime member of the Columbia County Board of Education, announced she will not seek another term representing District 2, ending a nearly 16-year run on the board. item.title: Barton Chapel Elementary hearing details two-year move and Josey High School transition
item.description: Richmond County School System leaders and board members met with families and residents on Monday at Barton Chapel Elementary School to explain proposed changes in the district’s 2026 Long-Range Facilities Master Plan and take public feedback ahead of a scheduled board vote later this month.
